info.title: Examance API
info.description:
Privacy-first anonymous exam grading backend.

## Key Security & Architecture Features
- **Zero-Knowledge Encryption**: Student PII, submission scans, and annotations are encrypted client-side (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM) before reaching the server.
- **Multi-factor sign-in**: a session needs a passkey (user verification required) or two distinct factors out of password, passkey and authenticator (TOTP). Fewer than two enrolled means an enrollment-scoped token that reaches nothing else.
- **Recoverable data key**: the client's key is random and wrapped per factor (`key_envelopes`), so a password reset re-wraps it rather than orphaning every vault. The server holds ciphertext only.
- **Session Hygiene**: State stored in HttpOnly cookies (`access_token` 15 min, `refresh_token` 7 days with rotation & reuse detection).
- **Privacy Safeguards**: LaTeX requests redacted in logs (`LaTeXRequest`), IP addresses stored as SHA-256 hashes.
- **LaTeX Engine**: Compilation rendered using sandboxed Tectonic (`tectonic --untrusted`).

post.description: Request a password reset link sent to the user's email address.

schema.title: Response Forgot Password Api V1 Auth Forgot Password Post

post.description: Ask for an account: mails a verification link to the address; nothing is created until used. Answers the same whether or not the address already has an account (nothing is mailed then), and the mail goes out after the response so timing does not tell either.

schema.title: Response Register Api V1 Auth Register Post

post.description: Verify the address with the mailed token and create the account with the chosen password. An address on the admin's always-allowed list is approved at once, any other account waits for an admin (notified). Neither issues a session: the registrant signs in and enrolls then.
What the mailed self-deletion link would delete, for the confirmation page. Deletes nothing: a mail scanner that opens the link must not delete the account.

GDPR Art. 17: delete the account behind the mailed single-use link (last admin refused). No session needed (the link proves the mailbox); exercises stay ownerless if the holder asked. Cookies are left alone (they may belong to another account; this one's tokens die with it).

schema.title: Response Confirm Account Deletion Api V1 Auth Account Deletion Confirm Post

post.description: Open a password reset with the emailed link (the token is *one* of the two required factors). Mailbox access alone must not complete a reset. An account that has not finished enrolling has no second factor to offer, so it gets a `reset_pending` token that completes it alone.

Set the new password and store the re-wrapped data key with it, in one transaction. A password without its key copy looks like a working account until a sign-in opens nothing. No envelope: the password wrap is marked unusable and the teacher needs the recovery code.

schema.title: Response Reset Password Api V1 Auth Reset Password Post

post.description: Change the password of a signed-in account, keeping the session. The client re-wraps the data key; wrap and password go in one transaction so they never diverge. The current password uses the `/auth/login` throttle, else this is a cooloff-free oracle.

schema.title: Response Change Password Api V1 Auth Change Password Post

post.description: Present the password as the *second* factor (`/auth/login` can only open a sign-in). The account comes from the pending token; taking an email here would make the second step an account-existence probe. Not reachable in the reset flow (the emailed token stands in).

Present an authenticator code as the second factor. Second position only: a TOTP code does not identify an account, so accepting it first would need an email alongside it, a probe for which addresses have accounts.
Spend a backup code in place of the authenticator. It counts as the ``totp`` factor, so it cannot be paired with a TOTP code to make up two: it stands in for that factor rather than adding one.
Verify credentials, set httpOnly access + refresh cookies. Response body contains only { email, role } — never the token value.
Issue new access + refresh cookies, revoke the old refresh token. Detects concurrent use (token theft) if the token is already revoked.

Clear auth cookies and revoke the refresh token. Deliberately needs no session, so a teacher with a half-finished or expired sign-in can still clear their cookies. The revocation is authenticated by the refresh token itself.
Start a compile (body limit: BODY_LIMIT_COMPILE) and answer at once with its `job_id`; poll `GET /compile/latex/jobs/{job_id}`. Passes get the full COMPILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, which no proxy sees.

get.description: 202 `{"status": "pending"}` while running, then once the PDF (200) or the compile's error response; answers at once, never long-polls.
List all non-deleted exams belonging to the authenticated teacher.

schema.title: Response List Exams Api V1 Exams Get

post.description: Create a new exam and live-link exercises from library or inline creation.
Copy an exam's header, settings, MC groups and exercise links into a new exam (issue #121). Never copies results: students, submissions and scores belong to the source only.

get.description: Get exam details with live-linked exercises.

patch.description: Update exam details and exercise links.

delete.description: Soft-delete an exam and start the erasure grace period of its student data. Retention skips deleted exams and only erases child rows with a deadline, so without the cascade a deleted exam's identities and submissions would be kept forever.

get.description: Get exercises linked to a specific exam.

schema.title: Response List Exam Exercises Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Exercises Get

get.description: Every pseudonym value of the exam, soft-deleted rows included, and their version: the input of a client-side rekey (issue #177). Reads are never gated.

post.description: Renames every pseudonym of the exam to the client's keyed HMAC and moves its version (issue #177). Compare-and-set on `from_version`; `changed: false` when already done; 422 unless the pairs cover every value.

get.description: Every asset with its SHA-256, so the client can verify what it fetched.

schema.title: Response Latex Assets Index Api V1 Latex Assets Index Json Get

get.description: One bundled asset; revalidated via ETag so edits ship with the backend image.
The packages and libraries the account adds to every document.

put.description: Replace the account's list. Entries are validated (names, options, unsupported packages).

get.description: What the exam template loads by itself, read from the bundled .sty files.
The account's logo setting (`default`, `none`, `custom`) and what it prints.

put.description: Choose the account logo: the bundled default (`default`), none (`none`), or its own file (`custom`, PNG, JPEG or PDF up to 2 MB in `content_b64`).

delete.description: Reset the account logo to the default; same as `PUT {"mode": "default"}`.

get.description: The logo the account prints (its own or the default); 404 when it prints none.
The exam's logo setting and the logo it resolves to.

put.description: Choose the exam's logo: follow the account (`account`), print none (`none`), or print its own (`custom`, with `content_b64` to replace the stored file).

get.description: The logo this exam prints (its own, the account's, or the default); 404 for none.
Proposals to the caller's exercises (incoming) or from the caller (outgoing).

schema.title: Response List Contributions Api V1 Exercises Contributions Get

get.description: Pending proposals: the incoming total (tab badge) and per own group (library tag).
The proposal; the owner also gets the current row it applies to and a file comparison.
A proposed file, for the owner and the contributor only; served like exercise resources.

post.description: Adopt a proposal as a new version (or a new variant at version 1); the owner may edit it. Nothing is updated in place, so the owner's exams keep the rows they link.
Decline a proposal (owner); its content is dropped at once. Never gated.
Take back an own pending proposal; its content is dropped at once. Never gated.

get.description: List the teacher's own library. Shared rows are listed by `/shared` and only ever copied, so the library, the exam picker and the offline mirror never hold another account's row.

schema.title: Response List Exercises Api V1 Exercises Get

post.description: Create a new exercise in the teacher's library.

get.description: Current exercises other accounts shared with the installation (read-only; copy to use).

schema.title: Response List Shared Exercises Api V1 Exercises Shared Get

get.description: For each own group copied from a shared one: whether the source changed since the last sync. "source_unavailable" does not tell unshared from deleted, on purpose.

schema.title: Response Get Sync Status Api V1 Exercises Sync Status Get

patch.description: Update group metadata and cascade it to every member variant.

get.description: Get an own exercise, or one shared with the caller (then without owner id or provenance, so `teacher_id` tells the caller whether the row is theirs).

patch.description: Update a library exercise in place.

delete.description: Delete an exercise from the caller's own library. Idempotent: always 204. Only exercises owned by *teacher* are deleted, so a foreign id is a silent no-op that does not reveal the id exists.

post.description: Create a new corrected version of an existing exercise (archives previous version).
Create a new parallel variant (e.g. Möbel/Fahrzeug/Wildtier) under the same group.

get.description: Get count and details of non-deleted exams referencing this exercise. Only the caller's own exams are reported, so usage of a published exercise in another teacher's exam is never disclosed.

put.description: Share an own exercise group (all its variants) with every account, or stop sharing it. Stopping is never gated, so a revoked account can still withdraw; copies stay with copiers.

schema.title: Response Set Exercise Sharing Api V1 Exercises  Exercise Id  Sharing Put

post.description: Share or stop sharing every own library group at once. Copied groups are skipped (never shared as one's own); stopping is never gated.

put.description: Hide (or show again) everything the account shares; per-group choices are kept. Pausing is never gated; resuming needs the sharing switch.

post.description: Copy a shared exercise group into the caller's library as a new private group that stays linked to its source. 404 for anything not shared with the caller, existing or not.
Duplicate an own exercise group (current version of every variant) as a new private group, e.g. as the starting point for a similar exercise (issue #121).

get.description: Per variant of a copied group: own current row, source current row and the source fingerprint the resync request must echo.

post.description: Bring a copied group up to its source: changed variants become new versions (the old row stays for the exams that link it), new source variants new rows. 409 if the source changed since the reviewed preview.

schema.title: Response Resync Group Api V1 Exercises Groups  Group Id  Resync Post

post.description: Propose variants of a linked copy to the original's author: changed ones as new versions, ones added to the copy as new variants. The author is notified and decides.

schema.title: Response Submit Contributions Api V1 Exercises Groups  Group Id  Contributions Post

delete.description: Detach a copied group from its source; the content stays, update notices stop.

get.description: List an exercise's resource files (metadata only, no bytes).

schema.title: Response List Exercise Resources Api V1 Exercises  Exercise Id  Resources Get

post.description: Attach a file to an exercise. Uploading an existing filename replaces it. The filename is sanitised and checked against the bundled LaTeX assets by the schema; SVG is refused there with a convert-to-PDF hint.

get.description: Return a resource's raw bytes (see `resource_response` for the XSS hardening).

patch.description: Rename a resource file (the LaTeX source must be updated by the caller).

post.description: Upload encrypted student identity ciphertext. Handles upsert for duplicate pseudonym_hmac.

get.description: List the exam's encrypted student identities that are not soft-deleted.

schema.title: Response List Student Identities Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Students Get

delete.description: GDPR Art. 17 Erasure — hard delete student identity + cascade submissions. Appends an immutable audit log entry.

get.description: List all non-deleted submissions for an exam.

parameters.name: include_scans

schema.description: Include scan_ciphertext_b64/scan_iv_b64 for every submission. Off by default: the scan PDF is the bulk of a submission's payload, so an overview listing all of an exam's submissions must not ship every scan just to show a table. Use has_scan for a presence indicator, and GET /exams/{id}/submissions/{sub_id} to fetch one scan's bytes on demand.
schema.title: Include Scans

parameters.description: Include scan_ciphertext_b64/scan_iv_b64 for every submission. Off by default: the scan PDF is the bulk of a submission's payload, so an overview listing all of an exam's submissions must not ship every scan just to show a table. Use has_scan for a presence indicator, and GET /exams/{id}/submissions/{sub_id} to fetch one scan's bytes on demand.

schema.title: Response List Submissions Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Submissions Get

post.description: Upload encrypted scan submission.

get.description: Download encrypted scan submission by ID.

delete.description: Soft-delete a scan submission by ID.

patch.description: Update plaintext total score for server-side statistics.

delete.description: Clear all grading data (score + annotations) for a submission.

schema.title: Response List Scores Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Submissions  Submission Id  Scores Get

put.description: Upsert the listed scores; unlisted ones are left alone (clearing is a DELETE). Rows resolve by (submission_id, exercise_id), never by the client's id, so a replay updates in place instead of answering 409.

schema.title: Response Put Scores Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Submissions  Submission Id  Scores Put
Response List Exam Scores Api V1 Exams  Exam Id  Scores Get

get.description: Accounts, newest first (Admin only). `pending` = waiting for approval.

post.description: Invite a teacher/admin: create the account without a password (Admin only). Approved with the given features; the address counts as verified because the mailed set-password link is the only way in. A pending self-registration for it is superseded.

Approve a pending registration with the given features (Admin only). Conditional on the account still being pending, so two admins approving at once send one mail. The registrant's note is erased: it only served this decision.
Reject a pending registration: the account is deleted and the registrant told (Admin only). Only ever deletes an account that is still pending; an approved one is refused.

patch.description: Change an account's feature switches (Admin only). Revoking `server_results` from an account in "all-server" mode does not touch its data: the next time it opens, the app asks it to move its results into the browser.

delete.description: Delete an approved account and everything it owns (Admin only). With `keep_exercises` its library exercises stay ownerless (`services/account_deletion.py`). Pending registrations go through `/reject`; admins delete their own account in settings.

post.description: Trigger an admin-forced password reset for an existing user (Admin only). Emails a single-use reset token; the existing password stays active until the link is used. For an invited account that never set a password this resends the invitation.

get.description: Domains whose registrations are approved automatically (Admin only).

schema.title: Response List Allowed Domains Api V1 Admin Allowed Domains Get

post.description: Approve every future registration from a domain automatically (Admin only). Exact match on the part after '@'; subdomains need their own entry. Existing accounts are not affected.

patch.description: Change the features future registrations from a domain receive (Admin only).

delete.description: Stop approving a domain automatically (Admin only). Existing accounts stay.

post.description: Clear a user's authenticator and passkeys (Admin only), the escape hatch for a lost factor. Does not restore data access: the server cannot read key copies, so the removed factors' wraps are gone; the recovery code stays the way back (else an admin could read the data).

schema.title: Response Reset User Factors Api V1 Admin Users  User Id  Reset Factors Post

get.description: Get paginated audit logs (Admin only).

schema.title: Response List Audit Logs Api V1 Admin Audit Get

get.description: The current window, its backup, and how many teachers are online / warned / ready.

post.description: Announce manual maintenance in `lead_minutes` (0 = now); replaces an open manual window.

delete.description: End the open window (manual or deployment); teachers can work and sign in again.

post.description: Cut the countdown of the open window short, e.g. when nobody is online (issue #149).

get.description: The account's storage mode (null until chosen) and what it may use.

put.description: Records the account's storage mode, compare-and-set on `expected`. Moving the results between server and browser is the client's job and happens before this call; this only states where they now live.

post.description: Soft-delete the teacher's student identities and scan submissions (hard delete after 7 days). LaTeX exercises, exam structures and their resource files stay (teacher-authored content). A file with personal data (e.g. a pupil photo) must be deleted with the exercise or itself.

schema.title: Response Purge Server Student Data Api V1 User Purge Server Student Data Post

post.description: Restore the teacher's soft-deleted student identities and scan submissions still inside the grace period, and list the live exams whose older results retention already erased.

get.description: GDPR Art. 15/20: machine-readable copy of the account holder's own data. Only what the server holds *about the teacher*: account fields, authored exams, audit trail. Student payloads are excluded (the server cannot read them); use the client-side export.

schema.title: Response Export Own Data Api V1 User Me Export Get

post.description: GDPR Art. 17: ask to delete one's own account; mails a single-use confirmation link. The link leads to `POST /auth/account-deletion/confirm` (see `services/account_deletion.py`). A new request replaces an open one; the last admin account is refused up front.

schema.title: Response Request Account Deletion Api V1 User Me Deletion Request Post

get.description: Return every wrap for the calling teacher, invalidated rows included and marked, so the client can tell a factor orphaned by an admin password write from one never enrolled.

put.description: Replace the teacher's whole envelope set in one transaction. Wholesale on purpose: merging could leave a new password wrap beside a recovery wrap holding the previous DEK, which looks healthy until someone needs to recover.

delete.description: Remove a single wrap (used when a passkey is deregistered). The recovery wrap cannot be deleted this way: it always works, and dropping it would leave the account one forgotten password from unreadable data.

get.description: What this account has enrolled, whether that is enough to sign in, and per-factor details for the security page. Only about the *authenticated* account, so it is no profile oracle for an email.

post.description: Start an authenticator enrollment. The secret is returned once, in the `otpauth://` URI, and never again: re-serving it would let anyone holding a session clone the second factor, while a lost setup just starts over.

Prove the authenticator works, which is what makes it count as a factor. Returns the backup codes once. They are the way back when the phone is lost, and they stand in for this factor rather than adding a third.
Replace the backup codes. The previous set stops working immediately.

delete.description: Remove the authenticator, refused if it would drop the account below two sign-in factors or below its last means of decrypting its own data. That guard makes "any two of three" safe.

post.description: Options for adding a passkey. Reachable from enrollment as well as a session.
Options for a passkey sign-in. Unauthenticated and rate-limited: it allocates a challenge per call, and it takes no account identifier, so there is nothing here to probe with.

Present a passkey as a sign-in factor, first or second; on its own it satisfies the policy. The cookie is read directly, not via a dependency, because this must work with no session (passkey first) and with a sign-in part-way through (passkey second).

delete.description: Remove a passkey. Refused when it would drop the account below two sign-in factors, or below its last means of decrypting its own data.

get.description: Whether this deployment accepts training-data donations. Public, read-only.

post.description: Store a batch of teacher-verified checkbox crops, unlinked from the account.

get.description: Configured retention periods. Public: no session, no personal data.
Public: whether maintenance is announced or running. Signed-in teachers count as online.

post.description: The teacher confirmed they saved their work for this window (shown to admins as a count).
Store a report and notify the admins (count and link only).

get.description: Reports, newest first (Admin only).
One attached file; served like exercise resources (only PDF/PNG/JPEG inline).

post.description: Mark resolved and tell the reporter by mail (with the optional note). Idempotent.

AccountDeletionTokenRequest.title: AccountDeletionTokenRequest
AccountDeletionTokenRequest.description: The token from the mailed self-deletion link. In a body, never a URL, so no log keeps it.

AccountFeatures.title: AccountFeatures
AccountFeatures.description: The per-account admin switches (app/services/capabilities.py): server_results ("all-server" allowed), server_latex (server-side compile), exercise_sharing (sharing/copying, issue #65).

AccountFeaturesUpdate.title: AccountFeaturesUpdate
AccountFeaturesUpdate.description: A partial change of `AccountFeatures`; omitted switches stay as they are.

AccountLatexPackages.title: AccountLatexPackages
AccountLatexPackages.description: The packages added to every document of the account. ``disabled`` has no meaning here.

AccountLogoUpdate.title: AccountLogoUpdate
AccountLogoUpdate.description: The account's logo choice: ``default`` prints the bundled default logo (MTG), ``none`` prints no logo, ``custom`` prints ``content_b64``. ``custom`` without content keeps the stored file. The type is read from the bytes, never from the client.

AdminCreateUserRequest.title: AdminCreateUserRequest
AdminCreateUserRequest.description: An invitation: the account is created approved, the address counts as verified.

ExamDuplicate.title: ExamDuplicate
ExamDuplicate.description: A duplicate gets its own retention window, like a new exam (issue #121).

ExamLogoUpdate.title: ExamLogoUpdate
ExamLogoUpdate.description: An exam's logo choice: ``account`` follows the account logo, ``none`` prints no logo, ``custom`` prints ``content_b64``. ``custom`` without content keeps the exam's stored file.

scoring_text.title: Scoring Text
scoring_text.default: Für jedes korrekte Kreuz 1BE; für jedes falsche Kreuz -0,5BE. Pro Teilaufgabe aber immer $\geq$0BE

ExerciseLinkCreate.title: ExerciseLinkCreate
ExerciseLinkCreate.description: Links an existing library exercise to an exam, with optional MC group membership.

ExerciseResourceResponse.title: ExerciseResourceResponse
ExerciseResourceResponse.description: Metadata only — the bytes are fetched from the download endpoint.

ExtraNotes.title: ExtraNotes
ExtraNotes.description: Karo block at the end of the exam; heights in cm, the layout fills the page within them.

KeyEnvelopeIn.title: KeyEnvelopeIn
KeyEnvelopeIn.description: One wrap, as produced in the browser.

KeyEnvelopeSetIn.title: KeyEnvelopeSetIn
KeyEnvelopeSetIn.description: The complete envelope set for a teacher. Replacement is wholesale and atomic: a partially written set is a locked-out teacher, so the endpoint never merges.

LaTeXResource.title: LaTeXResource
LaTeXResource.description: One file to place next to main.tex for this compilation only. Nothing here is persisted: the bytes live in the temp working directory and are removed with it. Teachers in all-local mode keep the only durable copy.

LatexPackageEntry.title: LatexPackageEntry
LatexPackageEntry.description: A package, TikZ or pgfplots library; ``disabled`` (exam level) drops an account one.

PseudonymList.title: PseudonymList
PseudonymList.description: Every pseudonym value an exam holds, live and soft-deleted, for a client-side rekey (issue #177).

PseudonymRekey.title: PseudonymRekey
PseudonymRekey.description: Renames an exam's pseudonyms from one version to the next; `pairs` must cover every value the exam holds.

PurgedExamResults.title: PurgedExamResults
PurgedExamResults.description: A live exam whose soft-deleted results retention already erased for good.

RestoreServerDataOut.title: RestoreServerDataOut
RestoreServerDataOut.description: Outcome of `POST /user/restore-server-data`, including what could no longer be restored (issue #181).

ResyncRequest.title: ResyncRequest
ResyncRequest.description: The variants to take over, by source row id -> the fingerprint the user reviewed (CAS); a subset is fine. `overrides` holds the user's edited LaTeX for some of them.

SharedExerciseResponse.title: SharedExerciseResponse
SharedExerciseResponse.description: Another account's shared row. Carries no owner id and no exam id, only the sharer's e-mail, which they agreed to disclose when sharing.

TemplatePackages.title: TemplatePackages
TemplatePackages.description: What the exam template loads by itself, for the settings overview.

tags.name: auth

tags.description: User and server management: accounts, approvals, features, allowed domains and the audit log. Admin accounts hold no exams or exercises.

tags.name: user
tags.description: Teacher data lifecycle management (soft-delete, 7-day retention purge, and restore that reports what retention already erased).

tags.name: mfa
tags.description: Authenticator (TOTP) enrollment and backup codes. Every sign-in presents two of the three factors: password, passkey, authenticator.

tags.name: webauthn
tags.description: Passkey registration and sign-in. A passkey is one of the three factors, and where the authenticator supports PRF it can also unwrap the data key.

tags.name: keys
tags.description: Wrapped copies of the client's data-encryption key. Opaque to the server: ciphertext, a public salt and public KDF parameters only.
